description: Golden dataset for the Northwind Cloud fixture corpus. Every answerable question has ground truth stated verbatim in exactly the listed sources; out_of_scope questions have no answer in the corpus and the pipeline is expected to decline.

questions.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
questions.reference: Refunds are issued within 30 days of the original purchase. After 30 days only account credit is available.

questions.question: How long does account credit stay valid?
questions.reference: Account credit expires 12 months after it is issued.

questions.question: What happens if I cancel an annual plan halfway through the year?
questions.reference: A partial refund applies: the unused whole months are refunded, but the current month is not.

questions.question: When is standard support staffed?
questions.reference: Standard support is staffed Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 20:00 UTC. Weekend cover is on-call only and handles Severity 1 incidents.

questions.question: What is the first response target for a Severity 1 incident?
questions.reference: 30 minutes, 24/7.

questions.question: How quickly do you first reply to a Severity 3 ticket?
questions.reference: Within 1 business day.

questions.question: Do the response targets promise a resolution time?
questions.reference: No. Response targets apply to the first human reply, not to resolution.

questions.question: Does a Severity 1 ticket escalate on its own?
questions.reference: Yes. Severity 1 tickets escalate automatically after 60 minutes without a first response.

questions.question: Can an account deletion be undone?
questions.reference: Deletion runs after a 7-day grace period, during which the request can be cancelled by replying to the confirmation email. After it runs, deletion is irreversible.

questions.question: How much does the Starter plan cost?
questions.reference: 19 USD per user per month, for up to 10 users, with community support.

questions.question: How many users can the Team plan have?
questions.reference: Up to 200 users.

questions.question: Is there a discount for paying annually?
questions.reference: Yes, annual billing is discounted by 20% compared with paying monthly.

questions.question: When is an invoice due?
questions.reference: Invoices are issued on the first day of each billing period and are due 14 days after issue.

questions.question: What happens if a payment fails?
questions.reference: A failed payment is retried three times over 10 days before the account is suspended.

questions.question: How are seats added mid-cycle charged?
questions.reference: Adding seats mid-cycle is prorated to the day and charged on the next invoice.

questions.question: Do I get money back if I remove seats?
questions.reference: No. Removing seats does not generate a refund; the seat count drops at the start of the next billing period.

questions.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
questions.reference: Credit card, SEPA direct debit, and bank transfer. Bank transfer is available on annual Enterprise contracts only, and cheques are not accepted.

questions.question: What happens when I add an EU VAT number?
questions.reference: VAT is removed from future invoices under the reverse-charge rule. Past invoices are not reissued.

questions.question: How long is customer data kept?
questions.reference: Customer data is retained for 24 months after the last account activity, then deleted automatically.

questions.question: How long are audit logs retained on Enterprise?
questions.reference: 24 months on Enterprise, compared with 12 months on Team.

questions.question: How is data encrypted?
questions.reference: In transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Encryption keys are rotated annually.

questions.question: Which plan includes single sign-on, and which protocols are supported?
questions.reference: Single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan and supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC.

questions.question: Is two-factor authentication available on every plan?
questions.reference: Yes. Two-factor authentication is available on every plan and can be enforced for all members by an account owner.

questions.question: Is SCIM provisioning available on the Team plan?
questions.reference: No. SCIM provisioning is Enterprise only.

questions.question: How much notice is given before a new subprocessor is added?
questions.reference: Customers are notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is added.

questions.question: How quickly are customers told about a security incident?
questions.reference: Affected customers are notified within 72 hours of confirmation, and the post-incident report is published within 14 days.

questions.question: Are you ISO 27001 certified?
questions.reference: No. Northwind Cloud is SOC 2 Type II certified, with reports available under NDA, but there is no ISO 27001 certification at this time.

questions.question: What is the API rate limit on the Team plan?
questions.reference: 600 requests per minute per token.

questions.question: What does the API return when I exceed the rate limit?
questions.reference: HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.

questions.question: Can I look up an API token after creating it?
questions.reference: No. Tokens are shown once at creation and cannot be retrieved afterwards.

questions.question: How many items does a list endpoint return per page?
questions.reference: 50 by default and 200 at most, using cursor-based pagination. A missing next_cursor means the last page.

questions.question: How do I verify that a webhook really came from you?
questions.reference: Each delivery carries an X-Northwind-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using the endpoint's signing secret.

questions.question: How long are failed webhook deliveries retried?
questions.reference: With exponential backoff for up to 24 hours. An endpoint failing for 7 consecutive days is disabled automatically.

questions.question: What does a 409 response mean?
questions.reference: The resource was modified concurrently and the request should be retried with a fresh version.

questions.question: How many account owners can a workspace have?
questions.reference: At most two account owners.

questions.question: Does a viewer use up a paid seat?
questions.reference: No. Viewers have read-only access, do not consume a paid seat, and are free on every plan.

questions.question: What happens to a very large data import?
questions.reference: Imports up to 100 MB run immediately; larger imports are queued and run overnight. Imports are atomic, so a failed import leaves the workspace unchanged.

questions.question: How long is the trial and does it need a credit card?
questions.reference: A trial lasts 14 days, requires no credit card, and includes Team plan features.

questions.question: What happens after a trial ends without payment details?
questions.reference: The workspace becomes read-only for 30 days before it is scheduled for deletion.

questions.question: Members are stuck in a login loop after we changed the SSO settings. What should we do?
questions.reference: The identity provider metadata is stale: re-upload the metadata XML and ask affected members to clear their session cookie. Sessions issued before the change remain valid for one hour.

questions.question: How long do export download links last?
questions.reference: 48 hours. Exports larger than 1 GB are split into 1 GB files and emailed as download links.

questions.question: Why did re-running an import create duplicates?
questions.reference: A repeated import creates duplicates only when the external ID column is absent. Re-run with the external ID column mapped, then use the merge tool.

questions.question: Can support reset two-factor authentication for a locked-out user?
questions.reference: No. Support cannot reset two-factor authentication on behalf of a customer; an account owner resets it from the members page.

questions.question: We are on Team and want SSO with enforced two-factor. What can we actually have?
questions.reference: Single sign-on requires the Enterprise plan, but two-factor authentication is available on every plan and can be enforced for all members by an account owner.

questions.question: Which is longer, the refund window or the data retention period?
questions.reference: The data retention period of 24 months is far longer than the 30-day refund window.

questions.question: Which mobile operating systems does the native app support?
questions.reference: The documents do not cover a mobile app.

questions.question: Who is the CEO of Northwind Cloud?
questions.reference: The documents do not say who the CEO is.

questions.question: Can I run Northwind Cloud on my own servers?
questions.reference: The documents do not cover self-hosting or on-premise deployment.

questions.question: Are you HIPAA compliant?
questions.reference: The documents mention SOC 2 Type II certification and the absence of ISO 27001, but say nothing about HIPAA.

questions.question: What is the support phone number?
questions.reference: The documents do not give a phone number; they describe ticket-based support hours and response targets.
